Record the total runtime of a script

Source: R/tinytrail.R
tinytrail_the_end.Rd

Sometimes it's nice to know the total runtime. Add tinytrail_the_end() at the end of the script; it records the time between tinytrail() and this marker as script_runtime in _tinytrail.yaml.

Usage

tinytrail_the_end()

Value

The runtime in minutes, invisibly.

Details

Caveat: if you run the code line by line, the time may not be reliable, because it then includes any pauses between lines.

See also

tinytrail() to initialise the trail.

Examples

# \donttest{
withr::with_tempdir({
  writeLines("Package: testproject\nVersion: 0.1.0", "DESCRIPTION")

  tinytrail("Slow analysis", name = "analysis.R")
  Sys.sleep(1)
  tinytrail_the_end()
})
#> analysis.R: 0.0 min runtime
# }
